_comment: v2.61-dev starting point for EURUSD: K2 logic with the ADR-normalised strategy pip (item 3). Apply on top of the source defaults. Backtest only: the G3 live contract still allows XAUUSD only, and the fail-safes are single-instance (items 1/2 of the gap analysis). Acceptance in the cTrader backtester with real ticks before any further use: PF(R) >= 1.20 over 2 years and in each half, max DD within the Monte-Carlo band (tools/monte_carlo.py). harness 2020-21 raw EURUSD: PF(R) 1.52 at 0.3 pip all-in cost, 1.18 at 0.8 pip; ~1.1 signals/day. Needs a raw-spread account; set CommissionSymbolPips to the round-turn commission (e.g. 0.7 for 7 USD per lot).
